# A meteor's fiery tail: an outer plum cone and a mauve inner one, base at the origin (the meteor's
# centre) tapering along +Z for 1.4 m; unlit. The game points +Z away from the meteor's motion.
new
material new Outer --base-color 0.435 0.114 0.361 --emission 0.435 0.114 0.361 --no-slot
material new Inner --base-color 0.431 0.318 0.506 --emission 0.431 0.318 0.506 --no-slot
add mesh cone --name Outer --vertices 6 --radius1 0.26 --radius2 0.03 --depth 1.4 --location 0 0.06 0.7
material assign Outer
add mesh cone --name Inner --vertices 6 --radius1 0.16 --radius2 0.02 --depth 0.75 --location 0 -0.02 0.4
material assign Inner
select all
shade flat
export trail.glb
